WARDOGS Item Index

WARDOGS Item Index is a community-made reference for the game's equipment, progression and economy. It brings item data, comparisons and weapon build tools into one place, with a layout inspired by the in-game shop.

What you can expect

  • Browse weapons, attachments, gear and ammunition, including stats, prices and unlock requirements.
  • Compare items and see which values come out ahead for individual stats.
  • Experiment with compatible attachments in Build Lab and compare stock and modified weapon values.
  • Explore the available armour, vehicle, ammunition and component data.
  • Look up class progression, unlock costs and economy information.

Sources

Information is compiled from publicly available WARDOGS data, gathered and combined into a format that is easier to browse and compare.

AI assistance

GPT-6.1 Sol was used to gather and combine the data, connect related items and stats, and design and build the Index. AI-assisted work can contain mistakes, including incorrect values, interpretations or comparisons.

Important notice

WARDOGS and its developers may change items, balance, prices, unlocks and other game systems at any time. Updates to this site may lag behind the game.

This is an unofficial reference and should not be treated as a source of truth. Check the game and official WARDOGS information when accuracy matters.

Affiliation and ownership

WARDOGS Item Index is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or officially connected to BULKHEAD or Team17.

WARDOGS and the game artwork, icons, item designs, logos and other game assets displayed in this Index remain the intellectual property of their respective rights holders, including BULKHEAD, Team17 and their licensors. This project claims no ownership of those assets. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Legal

To BULKHEAD, Team17 and anyone acting on their behalf:

This index exists for nerds, data hoarders and Hotzone sweats who want to min-max the shit out of their equipment. It’s built for the community, because I give a shit about the game.

The index combines publicly available WARDOGS data with information shared on UnknownCheats, Reddit and Chinese forums. I can’t vouch for how every third party obtained its data. Analysis performed for this project has been offline, without game-process injection or live-game monitoring.

This website does not provide cheats, exploits or instructions for abusing the game, and it never will.

If you represent BULKHEAD, Team17 or another rights holder and believe this website needs to change or come down, contact me on Discord using the same handle or open a GitHub issue. Explain the issue and provide a verifiable way to confirm who you represent. Blank friend requests and messages without that information will be ignored.

Changelog

All notable changes to WARDOGS Item Index are documented here. The format follows Keep a Changelog.

[0.1.0] - 2026-10-20

Added

  • Equipment catalogue with weapons, attachments, gear, ammunition, prices and unlock requirements.
  • Item comparisons with individual stat winners, ties and stored curve values.
  • Build Lab with compatible attachment and ammunition cards, build presets, stock comparisons and scope impact.
  • Armour, vehicle and component data with linked ammunition and projectile inputs.
  • Class progression, unlock costs and economy information.
  • About and Changelog tabs with project information, sources, AI assistance and release notes.
